sections.title: Power Gems
sections.note: 20 red gems for the Spirit of Power.

items.name: Mercay Island Shop
items.howTo: Buy it for 500 Rupees at any time.

items.name: Astrid's reward
items.howTo: Astrid gives it to you after the Temple of Fire.

items.name: Bomb Garden Cavern
items.howTo: In a chest in the Bomb Garden Cavern, on the way to Eddo.

items.name: Isle of Gust west ledge
items.howTo: In a chest on a raised platform along the island's west edge, reached by digging up an Updraft in the vent field.

items.name: Temple of Wind B2
items.howTo: In a chest on the west side of the Sandworm room on B2.

items.name: Oshus's reward
items.howTo: Talk to Oshus in his house after the Temple of Wind. If you don't, he mails it.

items.name: Mercay cave by the temple
items.howTo: In a chest in the cave you bomb open on the path to the Temple of the Ocean King.

items.name: Temple of the Ocean King B4
items.howTo: Defeat the three Phantom Eyes on B4 and open the chest that appears.

items.name: Temple of Courage 1F
items.howTo: In a chest in the north-west corner of 1F, behind a bombable wall between two tablets.

items.name: Temple of Courage 2F
items.howTo: Shoot the two Eyeball Switches in the south room of 2F for a chest.

items.name: Temple of the Ocean King B3
items.howTo: Shoot the Eyeball Switch in the north-east of B3 (seen from the trapdoor buttons' platform) for a chest by the pedestals.

items.name: Goron Island North Maze
items.howTo: In a chest in the North Maze on the way to the Goron Temple.

items.name: Great Ice Field ledge
items.howTo: In a chest on a high ledge in the Great Ice Field.

items.name: Molida Island Cavern ledge
items.howTo: In a chest on a high ledge in the Molida Island Cavern (the Old Wayfarer's first hideaway).

items.name: Spirit Island east side
items.howTo: In a chest on the island's east side, across the channel.

items.name: Bannan Island islet
items.howTo: In a chest on a tiny island off the west side, south of its lower section.

items.name: Temple of the Ocean King B7
items.howTo: Hit the Shock Switch in the north-east of B7 for a large chest.

items.name: Isle of the Dead hidden cave
items.howTo: In a chest behind a bombable wall in the island's hidden underground cave.

items.name: Isle of Ruins maze
items.howTo: After lowering the water, in a chest in the north-east of the maze.

items.name: King Mutoh's letter
items.howTo: A letter from King Mutoh arrives at any Mailbox after Mutoh's Temple.

sections.title: Wisdom Gems
sections.note: 20 blue gems for the Spirit of Wisdom.

items.name: Beedle's Shop Ship
items.howTo: Buy the 'Good Thing' from Beedle for 500 Rupees.

items.name: Zauz's Island chest
items.howTo: Glide with a Cucco to the chest east of Zauz's Hut.

items.name: Isle of Gust Miniblin Pit
items.howTo: In a chest in the Miniblin Pit cave, next to the one with Treasure Map #7.

items.name: Salvatore's letter
items.howTo: Play Salvatore's Cannon Game on Bannan Island once; a letter with the gem comes the next day.

items.name: Astrid's fortune
items.howTo: Have Astrid tell your fortune after the Temple of Wind.

items.name: Molida Island Northern Woods
items.howTo: Past the sun door, dig the soil patch at the entrance to the Northern Woods and open the chest below.

items.name: Temple of Courage B1
items.howTo: Shoot the Arrow Aimer in the north-east part of B1 for a chest.

items.name: Freedle's isle
items.howTo: In a chest just east of Freedle on Mercay's north-east isle.

items.name: Jolene's Letter
items.howTo: After the Temple of Courage the Postman hands you Jolene's Letter; deliver it to Joanne in the Old Wayfarer's Hut.

items.name: Temple of the Ocean King B9
items.howTo: Defeat the four Wizzrobes on B9 for a large chest.

items.name: Biggoron's quiz
items.howTo: Answer all six of Biggoron's questions correctly (20 Rupees a try).

items.name: Temple of Ice 3F
items.howTo: In a chest at the west end of 3F; drop a Bomb on the switch to lower the blocks.

items.name: Temple of Ice B1
items.howTo: In a chest in the locked north-east room of B1.

items.name: Isle of Frost south-west
items.howTo: In a chest on a raised platform in the south-west of the island.

items.name: Aroo's letter
items.howTo: A letter from Aroo arrives at any Mailbox after the Temple of Ice.

items.name: Temple of the Ocean King B2
items.howTo: Steer a Bombchu to the Shock Switch in the north-west corner of B2 for a chest.

items.name: Treasure Maze: Beginner
items.howTo: Clear the Treasure Maze's Beginner level (20 Rupees: four Boing Statues in 90 seconds).

items.name: Treasure Maze bomb wall
items.howTo: In a chest behind a bombable wall in the centre-east of the maze, once the maze is open to explore.

items.name: Cave by Bremeur's Temple
items.howTo: After lowering the water, in a chest in a cave south-east of Bremeur's Temple.

items.name: Boulder by Max's Temple
items.howTo: Push the boulder across the bridge just north of Max's Temple to reach the chest.

sections.title: Courage Gems
sections.note: 20 green gems for the Spirit of Courage.

items.name: Spirit Island
items.howTo: In a chest east of the dock, on the field by the shrine.

items.name: Masked Ship
items.howTo: Buy the 'Good Thing' from Beedle's Assistant for 500 Rupees (weekdays 10pm–midnight, weekends 10am–noon).

items.name: Isle of Gust Cavern Study
items.howTo: Bomb the cracked wall into the hidden Cavern Study, the Old Wayfarer's old room, and open the chest.

items.name: Temple of Wind B1
items.howTo: In a chest reached by riding the Gust Geysers on B1.

items.name: Temple of Courage 3F
items.howTo: In a hidden room north of the Blue Light on 3F, behind a bombable wall.

items.name: Mercay hidden cave
items.howTo: Hit the Shock Switch south of the bridge to open the hidden cave in the north; the chest is inside.

items.name: Temple of the Ocean King B8
items.howTo: Place the Triangle Crystal on the north pedestal of B8; a large chest appears on invisible ground.

items.name: Linebeck's reward
items.howTo: Defeat the Pirate Miniblins that board the ship when you first enter the Southeastern Sea.

items.name: Dee Ess Island dig spot
items.howTo: Dig at the bottom-left corner of the island's lower 'screen', where the Menu button would be.

items.name: Dee Ess Island Hinoxes
items.howTo: Defeat the two Hinoxes in the pit of the upper 'screen' for a chest.

items.name: Gongoron's letter
items.howTo: A letter from Gongoron arrives at any Mailbox after the Goron Temple.

items.name: Goron rooftop
items.howTo: In a chest on top of a Goron's home in the south-west; grapple across from a nearby rock.

items.name: Isle of Ember islet
items.howTo: In a chest on a tiny islet in the north-west of the island.

items.name: Molida Island islet
items.howTo: In a chest on a tiny islet just west of the Temple of Courage.

items.name: Bannan islet by Salvatore
items.howTo: In one of the two chests on an islet north of Salvatore's Cannon Game.

items.name: Uncharted Island cave
items.howTo: In a chest on a ledge in the island's central cave.

items.name: Temple of the Ocean King B1
items.howTo: Stretch a tightrope across the gap on B1 and shoot the Eyeball Switch from it for a large chest.

items.name: Isle of the Dead Rupoor room
items.howTo: In one of the four chests at the back of the Rupoor-filled room behind the bombable wall in McNey's cave.

items.name: In front of Doylan's Temple
items.howTo: After lowering the water, in a chest in front of Doylan's Temple.

items.name: Mutoh's Temple B2
items.howTo: In a chest in the south-west corner of B2.

sections.title: Spirit Upgrades
sections.note: Each spirit levels up at 10 and 20 of its gems, at the shrine on Spirit Island.

items.name: Spirit of Power (Leaf)
items.notes: Equip a powered-up spirit on the Collection Screen; only one at a time.

tiers.name: Level 1
tiers.howTo: Bring 10 Power Gems to the shrine on Spirit Island.

tiers.name: Level 1
tiers.howTo: Bring 10 Wisdom Gems to the shrine on Spirit Island.
tiers.reward: Stronger shield defence; less time lost to Phantoms

tiers.name: Level 1
tiers.howTo: Bring 10 Courage Gems to the shrine on Spirit Island.

tiers.name: Level 2
tiers.reward: Sword Beams three times as wide
